baseline: BRD Employee Onboarding (AHRO), Draft for Review, 13-Aug-2026; conflicting version labels retained
coverageRule: Historical test records are restricted, read-only and permanently non-operational. They cannot dispatch, gain authority, satisfy readiness gates or enter real outcome metrics. Static mappings are not executed assertions, source authentication, vendor certification or evidence of live readiness.

features.name: Control Tower dashboard, stage and workload visibility
features.availabilityNote: Live cards are observed data; empty/loading/error state must be recorded.

features.name: Case search, filters and operational list
features.availabilityNote: Search results are organization-scoped.

features.name: Individual onboarding intake
features.availabilityNote: Record form validation and duplicate protection.

features.name: Batch and campus/frontline intake
features.availabilityNote: Batch support does not make individual exceptions disappear.

features.name: Case overview, lifecycle and stage state
features.availabilityNote: Status labels require supporting workstream evidence.

features.name: Case tasks, checklists and business stages
features.availabilityNote: Mandatory gate behavior is observed; reopening is auditable.

features.name: Case documents, privacy and validation
features.availabilityNote: Local validation never proves authenticity or clearance.

features.name: Candidate portal and upload journey
features.availabilityNote: Candidate access is separate from control-tower membership.

features.name: Document scanner availability and quarantine boundary
features.availabilityNote: Unavailable scanning and quarantine remain fail-closed. Only current independently verified scanner evidence can clear a gate.

features.name: Case communications and monitored-email status
features.availabilityNote: Real email requires existing approved-mailbox controls.

features.name: Case explanations, activity and audit evidence
features.availabilityNote: Explanations aid review and do not supersede audit.

features.name: Action Center work items and human handoffs
features.availabilityNote: Assignment is routing metadata, not a permission grant or professional qualification.

features.name: Workforce transfer program lifecycle
features.availabilityNote: Transfer basis remains legally governed.

features.name: Transfer population import and reconciliation
features.availabilityNote: CSV mapping/versions are implemented; legal migration approval is not implied.

features.name: Transfer governance, authority and objections
features.availabilityNote: Current scoped permissions and explicit reviews govern decisions; role labels are not qualifications.

features.name: Transfer cutover and contingency actions
features.availabilityNote: A Go decision needs observed completed evidence.

features.name: Transfer operations, KPIs and post-transfer tracking
features.availabilityNote: Metrics are not legal or payroll certification.

features.name: AI Agents operational view
features.availabilityNote: Agent status and outputs remain reviewable.

features.name: Workflow drafting and recommendations
features.availabilityNote: Drafts are advisory and use normal approval boundaries.

features.name: Cited HR Policy Assistant
features.availabilityNote: Citations/limitations must be observed for the query.

features.name: Policy library, versions and expiry reminders
features.availabilityNote: Publication/expiry actions are governed.

features.name: Policy review and decision governance
features.availabilityNote: Pending/rejected/stale authority cannot publish.

features.name: Guardrails and restricted action handling
features.availabilityNote: A guardrail result is not a policy approval.

features.name: Systems, provider configuration and monitoring
features.availabilityNote: Configured status must be observed; no vendor sandbox is claimed.

features.name: Analytics and operational outcome KPIs
features.availabilityNote: Historical test records never enter live outcome metrics. Historical business outcomes require dated source evidence.

features.name: Bottleneck simulation and operational recommendations
features.availabilityNote: Simulation inputs/assumptions are not observed facts.

features.name: Client setup and organization process configuration
features.availabilityNote: Configuration scope requires authorized observation.

features.name: Process-file management
features.availabilityNote: Files are governed inputs, not executable instructions.

features.name: Organization membership and roles
features.availabilityNote: Membership changes do not grant decision permissions or establish qualifications.

features.name: Audit Trail browse and export
features.availabilityNote: Audit evidence requires an authorized observed fixture.

features.name: Archive, retention and hold-aware actions
features.availabilityNote: Only actually offered actions are tested; no destructive reset.

features.name: Permission-based human decision controls
features.availabilityNote: Named members need current client/case permissions and explicit version-bound human review. Ordinary access does not establish professional qualifications. Legacy specialist receipts are history only.

features.name: Default checklist configuration and snapshots
features.availabilityNote: New cases receive a saved snapshot; existing cases do not silently rewrite.

features.name: Targeted checklist profiles and job profiles
features.availabilityNote: Matching and precedence require observed configuration.

features.name: Readiness/SLA, early-tenure and privacy settings
features.availabilityNote: Legal/policy defaults cannot be invented.

features.name: Early-tenure Day-1/30/60/90/probation tracking
features.availabilityNote: Enabled schedule and human completion must be observed.

features.name: Learning Guide search, navigation and portable download
features.availabilityNote: The guide describes current authorized operations and retained evidence; catalog coverage is not proof of execution.

guideSections.title: Navigation and operational queues
guideSections.summary: Use the Control Tower for authorized operational work. Historical test records are separate, read-only and non-operational.
instructions: Select your authorized workspace.
Review current operational queues and ownership.
Use Cases history for retained records, never as evidence of live work.
exceptions: Shared demo identities cannot create cases or acquire real workflow authority.

guideSections.title: Intake and onboarding stages
guideSections.summary: Ordinary authenticated intake uses real case facts and explicit governance grants. The business stages are Offer-Acceptance Package, Background Checks, and Day-1 Readiness.
instructions: Create a case only with current case-flow and profile-edit access.
Confirm the Offer-Acceptance Package through its dedicated evidence-backed review.
Resolve Background Checks and mandatory workstreams before requesting the fresh human Day-1 Readiness review.
exceptions: General intake does not collect free-form candidate notes or medical details.
A score or status label never substitutes for authority or safety gates.

guideSections.title: Candidate documents and Employee Vault
guideSections.summary: Private uploads, scanning, authenticity checks and consent are distinct controls.
instructions: Issue candidate access only through authorized ordinary workflows.
Keep quarantined or uncertain evidence blocked.
Apply all-required evidence and fresh consent checks to Vault reuse.
exceptions: Local file checks do not prove identity or source authenticity.
Retained test portals cannot accept new uploads.
Privacy withdrawal remains independent of new collection approval.

guideSections.title: Human decisions and specialist handoffs
guideSections.summary: Membership, assignment and mailbox personas are not professional authority.
instructions: Review the exact case and evidence revision.
Check current client/case permissions, jurisdiction and evidence revision; reviewer roles are routing metadata.
Record the accountable decision without inventing external completion.
exceptions: Stale decisions and historical test records cannot authorize operations.

guideSections.title: Workforce context, frontline release and early tenure
guideSections.summary: Approved country-specific policies govern context and safety requirements.
instructions: Confirm work country and approved policy revision.
Keep medical, safety and BGV gates independent of weighted readiness.
Record actual start and dated human follow-ups under current authority.
exceptions: Unapproved starter policies are proposals, not runtime authority.
Do not infer historical success from current checklists.

guideSections.title: Workforce transfers
guideSections.summary: Transfers require country-specific approval, source-attested execution and evidence-fenced cutover.
instructions: Review population, legal basis and required objections.
Reconcile source and target evidence.
Obtain current independent cutover sign-offs.
exceptions: A Go label is not payroll or legal certification.

guideSections.title: AI-supported work and guardrails
guideSections.summary: Generated plans are advisory; explanations describe recorded evidence rather than hidden reasoning.
instructions: Review drafts before adoption.
Verify citations and limitations.
Escalate uncertain or adverse evidence to accountable humans.
exceptions: AI output never grants authority or proves an external effect.

guideSections.title: Policy library and grounded answers
guideSections.summary: Source extracts, case evidence and policy decisions remain separate.
instructions: Maintain drafts under scoped access.
Obtain required review before publication.
Check audience, jurisdiction, dates and source context at disclosure.
exceptions: Retired evaluations cannot provide a current accuracy or fairness claim.

guideSections.title: Provider systems and authorized channel checks
guideSections.summary: Separately authorized operational tests remain available; configuration alone does not prove provider execution.
instructions: Review connector mode and approved estate.
Use explicit, authorized operational channel checks only.
Reconcile uncertain effects without automatic non-idempotent redispatch.
exceptions: Historical test records remain permanently denied dispatch.
No simulated integration is represented as genuine external work.

guideSections.title: Communications and monitored replies
guideSections.summary: Verified transport, tenant attribution, recipient authorization and responder authority are independent.
instructions: Check the exact case-bound reply reference.
Quarantine ambiguous attribution.
Review durable delivery status and unknown outcomes.
exceptions: A shared mailbox identity alone cannot authorize a state change.

guideSections.title: Operational outcomes and commercial assumptions
guideSections.summary: Live metrics exclude historical test records. Commercial what-if estimates remain available with stated assumptions.
instructions: Check cohort, dates, source provenance and denominator.
Distinguish observed outcomes from estimates.
Do not treat aggregate what-if means as causal forecasts or case-level SLA rates.
exceptions: Historical test activity is not business performance or readiness.

guideSections.title: Governance, privacy, retention and audit
guideSections.summary: Sensitive access, legal holds, retention, independent audit readiness and release checks remain mandatory.
instructions: Use scoped access reports and current authority.
Review approved lifecycle policies and legal holds.
Verify independent audit receipts before regulated release.
exceptions: Tenant membership alone is not decision permission; ordinary access is not professional qualification.
Restricted history and protected effect journals are retained; retirement does not purge records.
